Neil Gaiman's 'American Gods' Lands Series Greenlight at Starz

This is huge!

A few things worth noting:

  1. Brian Fuller, of Pushing Dasies, early seasons of Heroes, and current Hannibal will be writing and developing.
  2. HBO was pursuing the rights for the series since 2011, but then eventually dropped out because they felt the script wasn't tight enough.
  3. Neil Gaiman is very closely involved with the overall creation and production of the show.
  4. Next to Gaiman and Fuller, Robert Richardson, Tarantino's cinematographer, is a writer.
  5. The first two seasons will cover the contents of the novel, with the proceeding seasons being written for television with Fuller and Gaiman.
  6. On a personal note, I've heard unsubstantiated claims that HBO intended to make it one of the most expensive miniseries in history, with each episode clearing 8million USD. I have absolutely no proof of that, just heard through the grapevine. If it's even remotely true, it'll be interesting to see what Starz does next.
  7. On the note of Starz, their current claim to fame is the Outlander series, which is reaching fairly positive reviews. (90s on RT.)
  8. Tom Hanks is also set to produce, which is pretty swell.

A few notes:

  1. Who will they cast as Shadow? Will they go big, or subvert and find a smaller actor?
  2. Who will play Mr. Wednesday? (Personal vote: Christoph Waltz.)

Honestly I am sold with Brian Fuller writing the show. A friend suggested I watch Pushing Daisies last year and I binged that series hard and fell in love with his writing style. I am interested to see where they take the series after the contents of the novel seeing as I think the novel wrapped up quite nicely.

I would say they should go with a more unknown actor so they can make the actor play the character rather than the other way around. For Mr. Wednesday I would put my vote to Paul Bettany. He has the right sort of humor I think for the part though Christopher Waltz would also do well.
I haven't realized that the same guy did Pushing Daisie and Hannibal. Both are unique and beautiful. With Neil Gaiman involvement I have no doubt that this show will be amazing!

I have to say I'm kinda looking forward to this.
